SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT temp.deviceCode) AS count FROM ( SELECT line.uav_code AS deviceCode, task.task_status AS status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY line.uav_code ORDER BY task.plan_time DESC ) AS rn FROM vm_air_line_t line INNER JOIN vm_order_uav_devices od ON od.device_code = line.uav_code AND od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status IN ('0', '1', '2') LEFT JOIN vm_air_task_t task ON task.flight_route_id = line.flight_route_id AND task.delete_flag = '0' AND task.plan_time < #{currentTime} WHERE line.delete_flag = '0' ${param.dataScope} ) AS temp WHERE temp.rn = 1 AND temp.status = '3'
